name: Loom
tagline: Loom is an async video messaging tool that lets you record your screen, camera, and microphone simultaneously and share a link instantly. Its AI automatically generates a transcript, title, and summary for every recording, and a chaptering feature lets viewers jump to the section they need. Teams use Loom to replace meetings, explain complex code changes, and give feedback on designs without scheduling a call.
